configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Same configuration on Windows, macOS and Linux. Requires VCPKG_ROOT to point at a vcpkg checkout. The 'external' architecture strategy is how an IDE knows to set up the Visual C++ environment for the Ninja generator; CMake itself ignores it, so it is inert off Windows. Without it, building on Windows outside an IDE needs a Developer Command Prompt, or CMake may pick up MinGW instead of MSVC.

configurePresets.name: ci
configurePresets.description: Adds --clean-after-build so vcpkg discards each port's buildtrees, packages and downloads once it is built; without it the Windows runner runs out of disk while compiling qttools with qtbase's buildtree still present. Also pins OPENTRACK_USERCONFIG so the runner-specific sdk-paths files are not picked up. Both are kept out of the default preset: the former forces local rebuilds to re-extract sources, the latter would override a developer's own sdk-paths file.
